args.query: Deno KV atomic transaction counter with optimistic concurrency check

results.title: p-map concurrency-limited async mapping
results.summary: Map an async iterator with p-map while capping concurrency and preserving result order.

results.title: p-queue bounded concurrency
results.summary: Enqueue async jobs with p-queue at concurrency 2, assert no more than two run at once, and exercise pause, start and onIdle offline.

results.title: Bottleneck rate limiting with concurrency, spacing and retries
results.summary: Throttle calls to a flaky API with Bottleneck using maxConcurrent, minTime spacing, priorities and automatic retries from the failed event, checked offline with timestamps.

results.title: p-limit concurrent async job pool
results.summary: Cap parallel async work with p-limit, tracking in-flight count and collecting results in input order offline.

results.title: Keyv in-memory store with TTL expiry
results.summary: Use Keyv's default Map store to set, get, and expire values with TTL offline.

results.title: async-mutex serialize critical section access
results.summary: Protect a shared counter with async-mutex so concurrent tasks update it without races.

results.title: Redux Toolkit + RTK Query with tag invalidation and optimistic updates, tested with MSW
results.summary: An RTK Query API slice with auth headers from Redux state, tag-based cache invalidation and an optimistic update with rollback, tested offline in Vitest against MSW 3 request handlers without rendering React.

results.title: p-queue priority async task queue
results.summary: Schedule async tasks with p-queue using concurrency limits and priority ordering, covering pause/start and size helpers offline.

results.title: Idempotent job cache with diskcache FanoutCache guarded by filelock
results.summary: Memoize expensive jobs in a sharded diskcache FanoutCache and run each one once across threads and processes with a filelock file lock, tested fully offline.

results.title: asyncio TaskGroup, timeouts and semaphores tested with pytest-asyncio
results.summary: Bounded concurrent fetches with asyncio.Semaphore, per-call asyncio.timeout and TaskGroup error handling, tested offline with pytest-asyncio loop scope config and async fixtures.
